details.description: GPT-4o mini is OpenAI's fast, affordable small model for focused tasks, positioned by OpenAI as ideal for fine-tuning and for distilling outputs from larger models like GPT-4o. This catalog entry is the gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 snapshot as exposed for fine-tuning through OpenAI's fine-tuning API. Knowledge cutoff is October 1, 2023.
advantages: OpenAI's model page states it is "ideal for fine-tuning" and lists Fine-tuning among its supported API endpoints.
OpenAI's model page recommends it for distilling outputs from larger models such as GPT-4o to achieve comparable results at lower cost and latency.
use_cases: Creating a custom fine-tuned model for focused, cost-sensitive tasks.
Distilling a larger model's outputs into a smaller, cheaper model.

notes: No deprecation notice found for gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 on OpenAI's deprecations page. OpenAI's fine-tuning/model-optimization guide table (SFT/DPO/vision/RFT) does not list gpt-4o-mini, but the model's own page explicitly states it is ideal for fine-tuning and lists Fine-tuning as a supported endpoint, so I kept the fine-tuning claim on that basis. Catalog facts list only text_input/text_output modality for this fine-tuning entry, while the general gpt-4o-mini model page also lists image input for normal chat use; kept the catalog's modality per instructions.
